property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any address candidate newOwner, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) on the correct contract always reverts if newOwner == address(0) (owner cannot be set to zero); the mutant removes that check so there exist inputs (newOwner == address(0)) where transferOwnership succeeds on the mutant but must revert on the reference.
change_summary: Require newOwner not zero removed, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)) to set owner to zero without reverting.
